sloka: सुग्रीव प्रिय कामेन यद् अहम् निहतः त्वया ।माम् एव यदि पूर्वम् त्वम् एतद् अर्थम् अचोदयः ।मैथिलिम् अहम् एक आह्ना तव च आनीतवान् भवेः ॥४-१७-४९॥
transliteration: sugrīva priya kāmena yad aham nihataḥ tvayā ।mām eva yadi pūrvam tvam etad artham acodayaḥ ।maithilim aham eka āhnā tava ca ānītavān bhaveḥ ॥4-17-49॥

translations.english: 'Had you sought my help earlier(before you met Sugriva), I would have restored Sita to you within a single day. I have been killed by you to oblige Sugriva. I would have handed over Ravana by the neck after killing him in the battle.
